# GeoIP reader fixture

`GeoIP2-City-Test.mmdb` is MaxMind's small, synthetic City test database;
never use it as production location data. Downloaded unchanged from
[MaxMind-DB test-data](https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/blob/main/test-data/GeoIP2-City-Test.mmdb).
Copyright and MIT license are preserved in LICENSE-MIT. This fixture proves
MMDB decoding, locale lookup and file-generation recovery without network access.
